$comment: HI-3378: every test wait and timeout, by name, in one place. Read with timing(name) from tests/timing.cjs. kind: hang (generous: only bounds a hung run; CW_TEST_TIMING_SCALE multiplies these), lock (when one run may take another's lock: never scaled), budget (narrow on purpose: a performance check), quiet (a window where nothing happening is the point), pace (a sleep that is the point of a test), interval (how often a wait looks), seam (a value given to Combwork's own CW_TEST_* seams). To check a narrow result, lower a value here, or in a file named by CW_TEST_TIMING (merged over these by name). tests/README.md, Timing.

test.hang.note: a unit test's own limit (vitest.config.ts testTimeout)

test.hangReal.note: a unit test doing real git or real processes at length

test.hangRealJj.note: a unit test driving the real jj

test.hangStress.note: a stress or soak unit test

wait.hang.note: a unit test's wait for a condition (vi.waitFor, expect.poll)

wait.hangReal.note: a unit test's wait on real git or a real process

wait.hangRealJj.note: a unit test's wait on the real jj

wait.interval.note: how often a unit test's wait looks

spawn.hang.note: a child process a unit test starts (its timeout: option)

spawn.hangReal.note: a child process a unit test starts doing real git or real processes at length

worker.start.note: a worker thread a unit test starts, until it answers

db.busyMs.note: a unit test's SQLite busy timeout: how long a statement waits for another connection's lock

hang.ui.note: an e2e wait for the window (and Playwright's default timeout)

hang.step.note: an e2e wait for a step of Combwork's (a start, a merge, a board change)

hang.slow.note: an e2e wait for slow work (an install, a build, a long merge)

app.readyMs.note: a test copy of Combwork starting until its window is ready

app.closeMs.note: a test copy of Combwork closing

workspace.openMs.note: a test copy opening its workspace

provider.foundMs.note: a test copy finding a CLI

git.lockRetryMs.note: an e2e git command retried while git's index lock is held

runner.lockStaleMs.note: the e2e runner's lane claims lock counted stale, when another run may take it: an ownership threshold on a shared machine, never scaled

sandbox.otherPollMs.note: how often the Sandbox checks look again for another run's Sandbox, one at a time on the machine, before theirs

sandbox.settingsOpenMs.note: Settings opening inside the Sandbox before its screenshot: nothing there to wait on from the host

sandbox.stopRetryMs.note: how long the Sandbox checks wait before trying a Sandbox's stop again, until list no longer holds it

sandbox.museRunMs.note: a run of the real Muse in the Sandbox (muse-real): an exec's bound, and the time a resumed TUI, which never ends by itself, is given before it is ended

scenario.fakeTurnMs.note: a scenario's whole turn on a fake provider

scenario.modelTurnMs.note: a scenario's whole turn in a model trial

scenario.quietMs.note: a scenario's turn end: quiet for this long, at least

poll.intervalMs.note: how often an e2e wait (lib.until) looks

poll.readMs.note: how long one look of a polling wait may take to read an element before that look counts as not yet (its .catch): a look, not a bound (HI-3382)

poll.clickMs.note: how long one look of a polling wait may take to click an element before that look counts as not yet (its .catch or a false result): a try, not a bound (HI-3396)

poll.watchMs.note: how often a test's background watcher samples state for its log of what changed (laneslotretry): a sample, not a wait

pace.tipGoneMs.note: a tooltip gone within this once the mouse has left, else the hover is tried again (lanestages; its own bound covers the tries)

pace.promptDrawnMs.note: a prompt pasted into a CLI drawn on its screen within this, else Enter goes anyway, said (lib.sendPrompt, #600, HI-3210)

lock.beatFreshMs.note: a test's helper process counts as running while its heartbeat file is newer than this (laneslotretry: it beats every 250 ms)

seam.fileLagMs.note: the delay openspeed gives each of main's file calls while a workspace opens (a slow disk acted out)

pace.trustSettleMs.note: Claude Code's trust question: "Yes" still selected this long later before Enter, so a Down still on its way would have moved it back (lib.chooseTrust, #218)

pace.pasteWindowMs.note: a CLI takes an Enter within its paste window as a new line: this long after the prompt is written before its Enter (lib.sendPrompt, #527); nothing on screen says when it ends

pace.typedEnterMs.note: a line typed into a fake CLI without its input log, then its Enter after this: the fake reads a typed line before its Enter, as a CLI does (lib.cjs)

pace.chordBeatMs.note: a chord's two presses a beat apart, as a person types them (keys)

quiet.keyIgnoredMs.note: a key press that must do nothing: no tab switches within this (keys: Alt+F in a project without that shortcut)

quiet.popupStaysMs.note: longer than a pop-up's 2 s close in the foreground: it doesn't close within this while the window is in the background (notifyonce)

quiet.nothingMs.note: a window in which nothing happening is the point of the check

pace.trustEnterMs.note: Claude Code's trust question: how long after an Enter on Yes before lib.chooseTrust presses it again (a dropped key, #218); a try, not a bound

pace.trustDownMs.note: Claude Code's trust question: how long after a Down before lib.chooseTrust looks again and sends another (a menu still drawing, #218); a try, not a bound

quiet.dayTipMs.note: no day's tip within this of a window's start: one shows 4 s after the window settles (App.tsx's showTodaysTip), so none by then is the check (tips.cjs)

quiet.tipMs.note: a tooltip that would show after its delay hasn't within this: a hover that fits shows none (onelinedesc, settingsnav)

pace.escapeAgainMs.note: a dialog not closed this long after Escape: Escape is pressed again (board.cjs; its tries bound the whole)

pace.typedDrawnMs.note: text typed into a pane drawn on its line within this, else Enter goes anyway (loopwatch.cjs)

pace.wakeTakenMs.note: a typed wake taken by the agent within this, else it is typed again (loopwatch.cjs; three tries)

pace.approvalAskedMs.note: Codex's approval question shown within this after a turn, else the prompt is sent again (codex-extra.cjs; three tries)

pace.resizeStepMs.note: a pane's width changed within this after a window resize step, else the next step tries again (paneheader.cjs)

pace.resizePixelMs.note: a pane's width changed within this after a one-pixel resize, else the next pixel (paneheader.cjs)

pace.turnStartSeenMs.note: a fast turn's start seen within this, else it's taken as over already, and the wait for its end follows (termsize.cjs)

pace.reloadedBoardMs.note: after a reload, the board's card shown within this, else the Task Board button opens the board (a click while it shows would close it); a try, not a bound (boardfold.cjs)

pace.dragMoveMs.note: a pause after each mouse move of a drag held still, so Chromium sends its dragover for that place before the next (boardscroll.cjs); a gesture's pace

pace.decisionGapMs.note: the gap between two decisions recorded on a card, inside the wake's settle, so they make one line (decisionwake.cjs)

pace.keystrokeMs.note: a key typed every this while a suite plays the user typing, well inside the typing pause (decisionwake.cjs: 4 s)

quiet.noStartMs.note: an action that starts no agent (Cancel on a start's question, a card assigned to a busy agent): no start, prompt or move within this (boardgates.cjs, doingmove.cjs)

quiet.refusedDropMs.note: a card dropped on a column its rules don't have: no move and no question within this (boardgates.cjs)

quiet.attentionOffMs.note: with the taskbar count and flash off, an agent's open question shows no count, badge or flash within this (taskbar.cjs)

quiet.scrollStoppedMs.note: a column at rest after a drag's scrolling stopped (at its edge, the pointer off the board, the card dropped outside): it doesn't scroll on within this (boardscroll.cjs)

quiet.todoChipMs.note: a card in Todo for an agent shows no card chip in its pane header within this (cardchip.cjs)

quiet.plainClickMs.note: a plain click on a card's number in a terminal opens no card within this (cardlinks.cjs)

quiet.wakeTypedOnceMs.note: a watch's wake isn't typed within this after the user typed once in the pane, inside the typing pause (cardloop.cjs: 4 s)

quiet.wakeHeldMs.note: a watch's wake isn't typed while its agent can't take it (working, stopped, compacting) within this (cardloop.cjs; shorter than its 4 s turn)

quiet.cancelledWatchMs.note: a card watch cancelled from the agent menu: a later change to its card wakes nothing within this (cardloop.cjs)

quiet.quitHeldMs.note: a pending quit waiting on a watcher doesn't go ahead within this while a card it watches is still in Doing (cardloop.cjs)

quiet.secondWakeMs.note: after the one line for a card's decisions, no second line for them within this, past the wake's settle (decisionwake.cjs)

quiet.decisionWakeHeldMs.note: a decision's wake isn't typed while its agent works, within this, past the decisions' settle (decisionwake.cjs)

quiet.typingHoldMs.note: nothing typed into a pane while the user keeps typing there, within this (decisionwake.cjs: a key every pace.keystrokeMs)

quiet.busyEscapeMs.note: an Escape on a card while its decision is being saved closes nothing and asks nothing within this (decisions.cjs)

quiet.switchWatchMs.note: a project switch watched for this, for a moment of the old project's counts shown (taskoverview.cjs)

poll.sampleMs.note: how often a watch for a brief wrong state samples the window (taskoverview.cjs)

budget.watcherReportMs.note: cw_wait_for_agents answers at once for a watching agent, well before its own timeout (cardloop.cjs: 20 s)

quiet.unitMs.note: a unit test's window in which nothing happening is the point (a debounce not firing, a watcher staying quiet)

quiet.briefMs.note: a brief window in which a pending callback or write would have landed

pace.frameMs.note: a window's next frame, or this long if it draws none (a quiet test window off screen draws its frames late): progress.cjs focusing for keys

quiet.laneLookedMs.note: a lane looks at a card's change within a second: nothing told or typed within this after a change that must tell nothing (lanenotices, lanewatch)

quiet.afterCancelMs.note: after Cancel in Remove All's question, nothing stops or is removed within this (removeall)

quiet.toastOnceMs.note: a second toast for the same thing would show within this after the call that could raise it returned (unusedwt)

quiet.listDrawnMs.note: a tab's loaded list draws what it draws within this once its header shows: here a notice that must not show (unusedwt)

pace.panelRestoredMs.note: a window's Progress panel restored open with its layout within this, else it is opened by its rail (progresslanes)

pace.tick.note: a turn of the event loop, or a clock tick so two timestamps differ

pace.shortMs.note: a short pause so a race window opens or an interval is measurable

budget.jjObservedMs.note: a move on main observed by the jj workflow within this, after a restart or with Waiting read often (jjreopen)

budget.mainStallMs.note: the longest main's thread may be held by a burst of commits merged into a folder's line (mergeburst)

budget.workspaceOpenMs.note: an ordinary workspace open answering, its file calls each slowed by seam.fileLagMs (openspeed, HI-1705)

budget.signAtOnceMs.note: a packaged agent's signed commit answered at once rather than after the signer's own limit (packaged-sign)

budget.unreachableRunMs.note: a command run through cw-progress with Combwork unreachable still runs quickly, not after a connection's timeout (packaged-progress)

budget.promptEndMs.note: an end that must come well before the slow path's own limit (a prompt answered, a run ended)

budget.scanMs.note: a scan that must stay linear on a large input

budget.logWriteMs.note: a log line written without waiting on the disk

budget.screenMs.note: a terminal screen rendered within a frame budget

pace.keysThenEnterMs.note: a line typed into an agent's terminal, then this pause before its Enter: the fakes (and CLIs) read a typed line before its Enter, not as a paste

pace.actionTryMs.note: an action tried once more that may not land (a second click on a button already busy): its own short timeout, never a bound

pace.renameAgainMs.note: a fixture file rename Windows refused (main has it open), tried again after this (antivirus.cjs)

pace.rearmMs.note: a fixture rewritten this often so a reminder stays due a fixed time after now while agents stop and start (antivirus.cjs, #561)

quiet.toldAgainMs.note: an agent's need told once: no second telling within this (its title blinking, a review coming and going: attention.cjs)

quiet.bannerStaysMs.note: past a finished banner's 2 s: a banner hovered, focused or waiting stays, and none waiting is dropped (banners.cjs)

quiet.finishGroupMs.note: a finish group (agents finishing together, gathered over 3 s) and its banner's time pass: one notification, or none (banners.cjs, bursts.cjs)

quiet.avSuggestionMs.note: the antivirus suggestion not offered (again) within this once agents run (antivirus.cjs)

quiet.folderWarningMs.note: a Codex agent started or its turn ended: no stray .codex warning (or no second one) within this (codexfolder.cjs)

quiet.setupOfferMs.note: Combwork has looked for the CLIs: no Provider Setup or provider banner comes within this (defaultprovider.cjs)

quiet.linkMs.note: a terminal path hovered or plainly clicked: no link marked and nothing opened within this (filelinks.cjs)

budget.copyQuietMs.note: a returned review copy's quiet minute (Combwork's own): a check made before it ends (copyquiet.cjs)

seam.deliveryOverdueMs.note: CW_TEST_DELIVERY_OVERDUE_MS: a delivery counted overdue this long after it was made (instead of 30 minutes; deliveries.cjs)

seam.silentMs.note: CW_TEST_SILENT_MS: how long a running turn may be silent before Combwork says its state is unknown (flightrecorder.cjs)
